els.text: Thousands of years ago, people began building permanent communities. Small villages slowly grew into organized cities with governments, jobs, laws, and shared traditions.

deck.name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu

name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu · Trang 4

els.text: A civilization is a large, organized society with several important features.
People live and work together in permanent settlements.
Leaders create laws and organize the community.
Farmers, builders, traders, soldiers, and artists perform different roles.
People record laws, trade, stories, and important events.
Religion, language, art, and traditions connect the community.

name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu · Trang 6

els.text:
Many early civilizations developed near rivers because water was essential for survival.

Rivers provided drinking water and helped farmers grow crops. Floods left behind rich soil, while boats made travel and trade easier.
Because food became more reliable, populations increased and cities began to form.

els.text: People begin farming and living in permanent villages.
Upper and Lower Egypt unite under one ruler.

els.text: Trade networks connect cities across Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.
The Shang dynasty rises in ancient China.

deck.name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu

name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu · Trang 10

els.text: Writing helped people keep records, share knowledge, and preserve stories.
Written laws explained rules and helped leaders settle disagreements.
Merchants exchanged food, tools, metals, cloth, and ideas with other communities.

name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu · Trang 12

els.text: Ancient civilizations created many of the systems that societies still use today.
They developed cities, governments, writing, laws, trade networks, engineering methods, and calendars.
By studying these societies, we learn how people solved problems, worked together, and built the foundations of the modern world.

deck.name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu

name: Báo cáo Lịch sử & Nghiên cứu · Trang 13

els.text: The ancient world may be far in the past, but its ideas are still all around us.
